# Tax Groups

Part of the **Accounts** API. Base URL `https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1` — replace the host with your own installation and the token placeholder with a real Bearer token (see [Authentication](/master/api-reference/authentication)).

## List tax groups

<Badge type="tip" text="GET" /> `/admin/api/v1/accounts/tax-groups`

Retrieve a paginated list of tax groups with filtering and sorting

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.


**Query parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|---------|
| `include` | string | No | Comma-separated list of relationships to include. Available options: company, country, creator | `company` |
| `filter[id]` | string | No | Comma-separated list of IDs to filter by |  |
| `filter[name]` | string | No | Filter by tax group name (partial match) |  |
| `filter[company_id]` | integer | No | Filter by company ID |  |
| `filter[country_id]` | integer | No | Filter by country ID |  |
| `sort` | string | Yes | Sort field | `sort` |
| `page` | integer | Yes | Page number | `1` |



::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X GET "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/tax-groups?include=company&sort=sort&page=1" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

```javascript [JavaScript]
const response = await fetch("https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/tax-groups?include=company&sort=sort&page=1", {
  method: "GET",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```

```php [PHP]
<?php

$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();

$response = $client->request('GET', 'https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/tax-groups?include=company&sort=sort&page=1', [
    'headers' => [
        'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}',
        'Accept' => 'application/json',
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
    ],
]);

$data = json_decode($response->getBody(), true);
```

## Create tax group

<Badge type="tip" text="POST" /> `/admin/api/v1/accounts/tax-groups`

Create a new tax group

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.



**Body parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|
| `name` | string | Yes | Tax group name. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |
| `company_id` | integer | No | Company ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `country_id` | integer | No | Country ID. Must match an existing stored value. |
| `preceding_subtotal` | string | No | Preceding subtotal label. Must not be greater than 255 characters. |


::: code-group

```bash [cURL]
curl -X POST "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/tax-groups" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
  "name": "VAT Group",
  "company_id": 1,
  "country_id": 233,
  "preceding_subtotal": "Subtotal"
}'
```

```javascript [JavaScript]
const response = await fetch("https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/tax-groups", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
  },
  body: JSON.stringify({
  "name": "VAT Group",
  "company_id": 1,
  "country_id": 233,
  "preceding_subtotal": "Subtotal"
}),
});

const data = await response.json();
console.log(data);
```

```php [PHP]
<?php

$client = new \GuzzleHttp\Client();

$response = $client->request('POST', 'https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/tax-groups', [
    'headers' => [
        'Authorization' => 'Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}',
        'Accept' => 'application/json',
        'Content-Type' => 'application/json',
    ],
    'json' => [
    'name' => 'VAT Group',
    'company_id' => 1,
    'country_id' => 233,
    'preceding_subtotal' => 'Subtotal',
  ],
]);

$data = json_decode($response->getBody(), true);
```

```python [Python]
import requests

url = "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/accounts/tax-groups"

    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
}

    "name": "VAT Group",
    "company_id": 1,
    "country_id": 233,
    "preceding_subtotal": "Subtotal",
}

response = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json=payload)

data = response.json()
print(data)
```
